claim_review_2026.primary_title: Local smoothing for the Euclidean wave equation
claim_review_2026.claimed_theorem: Sharp local smoothing for Euclidean waves in every spatial dimension n>=2 is claimed, with the Kakeya maximal conjectures and full Hausdorff dimension for all Euclidean Kakeya sets as consequences.
claim_review_2026.scope_note: The separate September 24 manuscript explicitly claims the 4D Hausdorff case only; M055 concerns all n>=4, so the October 25 local-smoothing-to-Kakeya corollary is essential.
claim_review_2026.known_caveats: A full-dimensional Kakeya consequence must be proved for each n>=4; the 4D paper alone does not settle the registered universal statement.
